answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The fixes are tiered: 'Fix these before launch' (1-8, with 1-3 named as the ones that can stop a reservation), then 'Fix soon after', then 'Smaller items', plus a 'What I'd do first' list. The reply also says 'I could not drive a real browser or a screen reader in this session', marks render-dependent findings as estimates, and asks for each fix to be run 'on a real phone with dark mode on, and with VoiceOver'.

mapping.title: Closed days can be picked; refused only at Confirm, with no way back
mapping.reason: Same as D06: the tool-page calendar accepts closed days, the refusal ('the library is closed that day') comes only after Confirm reservation, and the day can't be changed from the basket or confirm page, so the member has to start again.

mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'available from' date are never checked
mapping.reason: Same as D14: nothing marks or checks days before the available-from date, so a tool available from 21 October can be reserved for 10 October.

mapping.title: Tool-page day and basket session can disagree
mapping.reason: Matches D15: the day and the session are chosen separately and never reconciled, so the confirm page shows 'Saturday 17 October' for the tool and 'Wednesday 21 October' for the session.

mapping.title: Ten-minute basket hold lapses unannounced, with a generic error
mapping.reason: D10: the basket says only 'Items are held for you while you finish' and shows no time, and after ten minutes Continue says 'Something went wrong. Try again.' The review's point that retries keep failing is the same fault.

mapping.title: Drill names cut off, so the two drills look identical on a phone
mapping.reason: D03: names are kept on one line with an ellipsis, so both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, c…' at 375 px and the battery count is hidden.

mapping.title: On phones the search form sits below all ten cards
mapping.reason: D01: under 480 px the stylesheet puts the results above the search form, so a member has to scroll past every card to reach search and the date filter.

mapping.title: Filters button is an unlabelled three-line icon
mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only three-line button as the only way to the date and category filters. A visible 'Filters' label fixes that part of the same defect.

mapping.title: Desktop tab order reaches the results before the search form
mapping.reason: Wrong as stated. Per D01 the document order is form then results and the reorder applies only at 480 px and below, so on desktop the screen and the tab order agree and search comes first. The real mismatch is on phones and runs the other way; R6 already maps that defect (D01).

mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old list, with no message
mapping.reason: D02: a no-match search leaves the previous results, nothing is announced, and the member can't tell whether the search ran.

mapping.title: Search matches only exact phrases ('battery' vs 'batteries')
mapping.reason: Its example doesn't hold. The review itself names a drill '…one battery', which contains 'battery', so that search wouldn't leave the full list unchanged. Matching each word separately wouldn't make 'battery' match 'batteries' either. The real part, the missing no-results feedback, is D02 (R9).

mapping.title: Membership number rejects 'Ft-01234', 'FT01234', 'FT 01234'
mapping.reason: D17: the field accepts only 'FT-' plus five digits in capitals with no normalising, so the iPhone's capital-first 'Ft-01234' and spaced or unhyphenated forms are refused.

mapping.title: Mobile number rejects '+44 7700 900123' and '07700 900 123'
mapping.reason: D17 lists exactly these: the mobile pattern accepts only '0xxxx xxxxxx', so autofill's +44 form and other spacing are refused.

mapping.title: Double tap on Confirm reservation books the tool twice
mapping.reason: D12: the button stays enabled and shows nothing visible during the 1.5-second wait, and a second tap allocates a second reservation number.

mapping.title: Basket Continue also stays active, with no visible change during its wait
mapping.reason: This is a different button and page from D12, and not D10's hold fault. For about a second after the tap nothing visible changes, so a member on a phone can't tell the tap registered and taps again or thinks it failed.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge is 3.07:1
mapping.reason: D04: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 in the dark theme, below 4.5:1. The badge background matching the card is part of the same token fault and the same fix.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed in reverse date order on phones
mapping.reason: D11: row-reverse with wrap-reverse puts the earliest session last, while the keyboard and screen readers follow document order.

mapping.title: After 'Reserve this tool' the toast is brief and nothing leads to the basket
mapping.reason: This is about the feedback after the press: a 1.2-second toast and only the small 'Basket (1)' link, fixed with a message that stays and a basket link. It doesn't say the member believes the tool is reserved, so it maps to D07, not D26.

mapping.title: Fixed bottom bar covers the focused day and the footer
mapping.reason: D08: the 72 px bar has only 8 px of clearance, so a focused calendar day can sit under it and the desk phone number in the footer is hidden.

mapping.title: Loan-length list can't be left with Tab, Escape or an outside tap
mapping.reason: D09: Tab cycles inside the custom listbox and Escape does nothing, so a keyboard user can leave only by choosing. The outside-tap point is the same can't-dismiss fault, and the radio-button fix removes both.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day' error not announced; focus jumps to a closed day
mapping.reason: D19: the message is in no live region and the calendar doesn't reference it, and focus moves to the first day button, which is a closed day.

mapping.title: Done page leaves the basket full and the hold timer running
mapping.reason: D18: after 'Reservation confirmed' the basket isn't emptied and still lists the tool as held. The review's fix, clearing it on confirmation, removes the defect.

mapping.title: Done page opened without a reservation shows a made-up number
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. A member who reopens the done page later, for example from history, sees a reservation number that isn't theirs presented as real, and may quote it at the desk.

mapping.title: Reservation numbers look like membership numbers
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. Both are 'FT-' plus digits (FT-4471, FT-01234), so at the desk or on the form a member can easily give or type one for the other.

mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice to screen readers
mapping.reason: D24: a visually hidden copy (#c-tool) next to the visible list item makes screen readers repeat the reserved tool's name.

mapping.title: 'Change' link's name doesn't say what it changes
mapping.reason: This is about the link's name, not D13's dropped session. A screen-reader member who tabs to it or lists links hears only 'Change' and has to explore around it to learn that it changes the pick-up session.

mapping.title: Results grid's 330 px minimum column scrolls sideways at 320 px and 200% zoom
mapping.reason: Exactly D05: the 330 px minimum column overflows the content box at 320 px and at 200% zoom.

mapping.title: 'Up to three tools' limit isn't enforced
mapping.reason: D21: the basket takes a fourth tool and the reservation is confirmed, although the find page states a limit of three.

mapping.title: Done-page fallback points to a confirmation text members aren't told about
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. When the fallback shows, it sends the member to look for a text message the site never said would come, so they're left without their reservation details.
